user.title: Home Orangery — Module Selection
user.description: Enter an instance name and select the automation modules to enable.

data_description.instance_name: Name assigned to created devices and entities (for example: “Orangery”, “Loggia”, “Greenhouse”, “Winter Garden”, or “Balcony”).
data_description.enable_logging: Global mode for writing errors to Logbook, sending push notifications, and announcing errors on speakers.

blinds.title: Blind control
blinds.description: Select the blind drives and additional blind control features.

data_description.split_weekend_schedule: Disable if every day of the week should follow a single unified schedule (without separating workdays and days off).

time.title: Schedule and sun
time.description: Configure automatic sunrise opening and sunset closing times.

data.up_time_workday: But on weekdays no earlier than
data.up_time_weekend: But on weekends no earlier than

data_description.up_time_weekend: Blinds will open at the specified time if “Open at sunrise” is unchecked.
data_description.down_time: Blinds will close at the specified time if “Close at sunset” is unchecked.

data_description.blinds_for_protect: You can select specific blind drives to use for direct sun protection. If none are selected, all blind drives will be used.

sun_protect_angles.title: Direct sun protection
sun_protect_angles.description: Configure the protection trigger angles. Blinds will close automatically when the sun enters the specified sectors.

data_description.sun_azimuth: Angle between north and the direction of the sun.
data_description.sun_elevation: Angle of the sun above the horizon.

weather.title: Weather forecast
weather.description: Sun protection will be active only under the selected weather conditions.

yandex.title: Voice control
yandex.description: Configure voice commands (phrases separated by ;) and TTS output method.

data_description.voice_engine: Defaults to Yandex Station (yandex_intent). Select Home Assistant Assist / TTS for other speakers.
data_description.tts_entity: Used only for standard Home Assistant TTS (Piper, Google, Silero, etc.). Leave empty for Yandex Station.
data_description.voice_event: Defaults to yandex_intent. You can specify any custom event on the HA bus.

device.title: Control device
device.description: Settings for physical rotary buttons or sliders

data_description.slider_mode: Full travel — blinds move to the end. Step — changes by N%. Proportional — mathematically calculates swipe length (for sliders).
data_description.slider_step: Used for step mode — the main mode for rotary buttons.
data_description.slider_fast_speed: Sliders only! If gesture speed is above the threshold — blinds move to the limit. Below — proportional/step.

device_payloads.title: Device command settings
device_payloads.description: Specify the messages your device sends for different actions.

limits.title: Travel limits
limits.description: Configure upper and lower limits for opening/closing the blinds.

repeats.title: Retries and timings
repeats.description: Protection settings against blind drive failures.

data_description.repeat_for: The integration will send the command as many times as specified here.
data_description.movement_time: After this time following the commands, the integration will verify the blind position.

logging.title: Error logging and notifications
logging.description: Write errors to Logbook, send push notifications, and announce errors on speakers.

data.yandex_media_player: Media players / speakers for error announcements

data_description.yandex_media_player: If speakers are selected, equipment errors and low battery warnings will be announced on them.
data_description.voice_engine: Defaults to Yandex Station. Select Home Assistant Assist / TTS for other speakers.
data_description.tts_entity: Used only for standard Home Assistant TTS. Leave empty for Yandex Station.
data_description.low_battery_threshold: When battery level drops below this threshold, a notification is sent and a warning is created in Repairs.

phytolamp.title: Plant lighting
phytolamp.description: Select plant grow light entities and settings mode.

data_description.phytolamp: Select one or more switch / light entities controlling your grow lights.
data_description.phytolamp_use_main_settings: When enabled, lighting uses the main integration schedule. Uncheck to configure custom schedule and conditions for plant lighting.
data_description.split_weekend_schedule: Disable if every day of the week should follow a single unified schedule (without separating workdays and days off).

phytolamp_settings.title: Custom plant lighting settings
phytolamp_settings.description: Configure additional conditions and custom schedule for plant lighting.

data.phytolamp_on_time_workday: Turn on lighting on weekdays at
data.phytolamp_on_time_weekend: Turn on lighting on weekends at

data_description.phytolamp_extras: Select parameters to configure separately for plant lighting.

phytolamp_sun.title: Plant lighting — Sun position
phytolamp_sun.description: Configure custom sun angles (azimuth and elevation) for plant lighting.

data_description.phytolamp_sun_azimuth: Angle between north and the direction of the sun.
data_description.phytolamp_sun_elevation: Angle of the sun above the horizon.

phytolamp_weather.title: Plant lighting — Weather forecast
phytolamp_weather.description: Select the weather sensor and weather conditions for plant lighting.

phytolamp_illuminance.title: Plant lighting — Illuminance
phytolamp_illuminance.description: Select the illuminance sensor and custom thresholds for plant lighting.

watering.title: Plant watering
watering.description: Select watering valves / pumps and a default schedule template for all zones (each zone can be configured individually on the “Watering” subdevice card).

data_description.watering_valves: Select all controlled watering valves or pumps (executed sequentially).
data_description.watering_default_morning_mode: Applied to all selected zones during initial setup.

watering_moisture.title: Plant watering — Soil moisture sensors
watering_moisture.description: Specify the soil moisture threshold (scheduled watering is skipped when exceeded) and map soil moisture sensors to the selected valves.

data.watering_soil_threshold: Do not water if moisture is above

work_week.title: Work week
work_week.description: Configure the alternation of workdays and days off (5/2 workweek by default, 2/2, 3/3 shifts, etc.) and public holiday handling.

data.use_holidays: Use weekend schedule on public holidays

data_description.cycle_start_date: For a standard Mon–Fri workweek, leave any Monday; for shift schedules (2/2, 3/3, 1/3), select the first workday of your shift.
data_description.use_holidays: Automatically accounts for official public holidays and transferred days off based on the country set in Home Assistant.

blinds_error.title: {title}: blind drive errors
blinds_error.description:
Blind drives did not reach the target position during the last command: {devices}.

Check power and wireless connectivity for these drives. This issue will clear automatically once the drives reach their target position.

phytolamp_error.title: {title}: plant lighting errors
phytolamp_error.description:
Plant lighting switches or lights did not change state on command: {devices}.

Check device availability on your network. This issue will clear automatically once the devices respond.

watering_error.title: {title}: plant watering errors
watering_error.description:
Issues detected with watering valves or soil moisture sensors: {devices}.

Check valve connectivity and soil sensor batteries. This issue will clear automatically once the devices recover.

low_battery.title: {title}: low battery level
low_battery.description:
Battery level dropped below the {threshold}% threshold: {devices}.

Replace or recharge the batteries. This issue will clear automatically once the battery recovers.
